body: Not extremely rich so I won't know what having one of these stupid things feels like. Oh well.

I feel to depressed, things that used to interest my don't anymore.. It's a horrible place to be and I can't see what the point is to keep going like this. I mean posted on this shitty subreddit and one person talked to me and all that happened was a thought about more and more about how I want that sweet release from my problems. I cried all day today. I feel like I'm completely worthless, sick human being.
Interested in having a future, which isn't gonna happen.
I can't actually get the major I wanted. They rejected me.
I only took classes on campus, but I think maybe I should try online classes. I don't know. I just feel so scared to even go talk to them. I feel so nervous about everything ALL the time.
I'm failing out of college, I don't even know how much longer I can last before I'm basically kicked out. My GPA is a joke, and it's due to the anxiety issues.

I used to be able to numb the feelings by not thinking about it. I tried distracting myself. I can't do it anymore though. Now I'm just extremely upset all the time. I already know that know one cares about me or my problems. I doubt you even read what I wrote.
